entries.0352b16ce5010fd7: The Business Description section of the filing prints that, for urban condominiums sold by the Investment Business, the Management Business of the stock segment takes on real estate management work, enabling continuous service to real estate owners, which is a feature of the company; and it prints that Jasutoin Co., Ltd. was established mainly to achieve efficient and effective corporate group activities through the separation of ownership and operation, and that operating work is entrusted to it.
entries.096ab131df2f6edf: Revenue for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥5,499 million, up 1.1% year on year.
entries.0a127bb3d655cf7b: YAMACHUU Co., Ltd. has its head office in Ōharu-chō, Kaifu-gun, Aichi Prefecture, and together with its consolidated subsidiary Jasutoin Co., Ltd., conducts real estate-related business mainly in Aichi Prefecture and surrounding areas.
entries.0c5a7026110a5a0d: This business operates 3 business hotels under the “Just In” brand in Aichi and Mie prefectures.
entries.0f50d47583943cca: This business operates 3 hotels: “Just In Premium Nagoya Station”, “Just In Premium Toyohashi Station Shinkansen Exit” and “Just In Matsusaka Station Front”. entries.105e05a9f3fcc944: This business operates the rental meeting room “Taimu Ofisu” (1 location in Nagoya City), the rental offices “Ofisu Purasu” (2 locations in Nagoya City), and monthly apartments with furniture and appliances, “Mansurī Purasu”. entries.1c5a35d575682ed2: The company combines flow income from developing and selling condominiums and residential land with stock income from managing sold properties under management contracts, leasing properties it owns and operating business hotels.
entries.1d43a5a918c2d68d: YAMACHUU Co., Ltd. has its head office in Ōharu-chō, Kaifu-gun, Aichi Prefecture, and together with its consolidated subsidiary Jasutoin Co., Ltd., conducts real estate-related business mainly in Aichi Prefecture and surrounding areas. As of April 30, 2026, the number of consolidated employees was 44.
entries.20f319088beea3c9: Condominiums are sold to real estate companies and individuals, and residential land is sold to individuals, builders of built-for-sale homes and purchasing businesses; the company receives management work from real estate owners and management associations for the properties sold. Business hotels are used by guests on business and sightseeing trips.
entries.31a44298b37e2910: Under its management philosophy of sanpō-yoshi, the spirit of “good for the seller,” “good for the buyer” and “good for society,” the company aims to stabilize group-wide performance by balancing the revenue mix between the flow business of the development segment, which earns income on each transaction, and the stock business of the stock and hotel segments, which secures continuous and stable income.
entries.31f067e4819a45dc: For the fiscal year ended April 2026, the company recorded net income attributable to owners of the parent of ¥547 million.
entries.3f2f995d6b19a6ba: Its strength lies in an integrated structure: for urban condominiums sold by the development segment, the management business of the stock segment takes on tenant recruitment, rent collection and other management work, so it can provide continuous services to real estate owners even after sale. In addition, the operation of hotels and rental spaces is concentrated in its consolidated subsidiary Jasutoin Co., Ltd., which was established to pursue efficient group activities through the separation of ownership and operation.

entries.aa317d8914eddc7b: Under its management philosophy of sanpō-yoshi, the spirit of “good for the seller,” “good for the buyer” and “good for society,” the company aims to stabilize group-wide performance by balancing the revenue mix between the flow business of the development segment, which earns income on each transaction, and the stock business of the stock and hotel segments, which secures continuous and stable income. The core of the growth strategy is active development of business hotels: the company has started construction of its fourth hotel, “Jasutoin Premium Tōkai Ōtagawa-ekimae,” ahead of its opening in May 2027, and has also decided to develop a new business hotel as its fifth. Other measures include expanding its business area, strengthening its ability to gather real estate information and strengthening its financial structure.
